item.title: SASSA Older Persons Grant 2026: R2,400 Amount, May Payment Date & eLife Alert
item.description: The SASSA Older Persons Grant increased to R2,400 in April 2026. Here are the current amounts, May 2026 payment date, eLife certification requirement, and how to apply.

item.title: Diesel Price Forecast June 2026: CEF Data Signals a Decrease
item.description: The CEF daily basic fuel price shows an over-recovery of 78 c/l for diesel as Brent crude drops from $126 to $101. Here is what June 2026 could look like.

item.title: Petrol Price Increase June 2026: Why South Africans Pay More
item.description: Petrol prices are rising in June 2026 as fuel levy relief is halved and global crude oil prices stay high. Here is what is happening and why.

item.title: SASSA SRD Grant June 2026: Still R370, Extended to March 2027
item.description: The SRD grant stays at R370 for June 2026 — no increase from the 2026 Budget, but extended to March 2027. Payment dates, eligibility, and how to check your status.
